callable_api.refusals: lace and poe_ebm raise RivalRefusal: both are sampler draws, not functions of the request. Off-grid values are refused by every family whose input is a class index.
callable_api.usage: from chlu.eval.rivals.w4_api import load_rival; r = load_rival(seed, name); feats, out_of_range = r(values)
callable_api.values: (N, F) float in the order given by r.names; np.nan means that factor was not requested

fit_population.NOT_LIKE_FOR_LIKE: On rows 2 and 5 these rivals are NOT comparable with an arm fitted on a value-holdout pool: they saw the value, it did not. The mechanism can enter the row; the fit cannot. Report with a population footnote and do not count such a rival as beating a value-holdout arm, or refit it on your own pool.
fit_population.check_mechanically: load_rival(seed, name).like_for_like({'object_hue': [0.5]}) returns a verdict with the number of fitted rows carrying each value; every checkpoint also carries population.n_per_value

held_out_values_seen.note: the two values chlu.data.gen_value_holdout declares as its hold-outs are BOTH present in this fit pool - measured: 3,157 rows at object_hue 0.5 and 7,972 at shape 0.0

fit_population.name: montero_combination
fit_population.what_it_contains: every factor VALUE; only COMBINATIONS are held out

param_match.target_basis: the prototype table's own count, (sum_k C_k + 1) x D; 475136 B at float32, which is GenCellConfig.prototype_table_bytes_reference

population.scored_sets: B (the Montero recombination-to-element corner) against MS (its photometrically matched-seen control)
population.split: a COMBINATION hold-out, NOT the value hold-out
population.warning: MEASURED: every value appearing in B, MS, fit and val also appears in the fit pool, so none of these numbers is row-2 territory and none is evidence about a value the arm never held. The only numbers in this spoke that are about an unheld value are the deletion comparator's. Do not read a rival number here against a number taken from the value-holdout test index: that index is mostly rows carrying a value no training row holds, and the two are different populations.

what_each_statistic_is_on.deletion_comparator: forget/retain sets defined by a value REMOVED from the arm's fit pool - the only numbers in this spoke that are about an unheld value
what_each_statistic_is_on.val_mse_full_schedule: the stratified validation rows, retained-values-only, fully specified requests
what_each_statistic_is_on.val_mse_partial_requests: the same rows with a random subset of factors requested

rescore_generation2.coverage_caveat: only 2 of 3 seeds contributed a generation-2 manifest (['0', '2']); seeds ['1'] are declared NOT RUN with their reason. A seed spread computed from fewer than three seeds is weaker evidence and the verdict below inherits that.
rescore_generation2.read_this_first: The three DETERMINISTIC arms (clu, knn_proto, store_removed) move by EXACTLY 0.0000 between generations on every seed compared. Every arm that moves is a SAMPLER arm, where a difference between two independent runs is expected regardless of the cache. The one arm tripping the seed-spread rule is lace/ld_corrected, a companion Langevin leg, at 0.0177 against a 0.0151 spread, on one seed of two.
rescore_generation2.verdict: AT LEAST ONE ARM MOVES BY MORE THAN ITS SEED SPREAD - report this to every hub before it scores against generation 2

rules: GENERATION 2 ONLY. Never quote a number from this set beside a generation-1 number, in either direction.
